method: host obligations read from the production validator source; prompt coverage tested by marker phrases in the sent production prompt
repaired_defect: factual_claim_source_binding (the only material unstated obligation found in C4.2)

obligations.host_obligation: every claim source ref must be a lawful FACTUAL SOURCE REF (inspectable content; subject/entity/environment are never factual sources)
obligations.prompt_marker: every ref must appear in FACTUAL SOURCE REFS

obligations.host_obligation: every claim source ref must appear in BOTH cognition.considered_context_refs AND cognition.evidence_refs
obligations.prompt_marker: must ALSO be listed in cognition.considered_context_refs AND in cognition.evidence_refs

obligations.host_obligation: the cited ref must have inspectable source content
obligations.prompt_marker: each carries inspectable factual source content

obligations.host_obligation: SOURCE_QUOTE text must be an exact substring of each cited source
at most 8 claims, each text non-empty and at most 512 code points, source_refs non-empty/unique/sorted
relevant_memory_refs / considered_context_refs / evidence_refs must be sorted and unique
obligations.prompt_marker: Refs in all cognition arrays must be exact, unique and sorted

obligations.host_obligation: confidence and uncertainty are numbers in [0,1]
cognition.action_intent must be null for the text-response path
the model must not emit projection_hash; the host injects the authoritative value
obligations.prompt_marker: Do NOT output any projection hash

obligations.host_obligation: CLARIFY requires a non-null basis whose current_observation_ref appears in considered_context_refs; REALIZE requires exactly null
subjective_choice is a tagged object; NOT_APPLICABLE admits only {kind}; SELECTED requires {kind, stance, subjective_rationale}
stance and rationale are canonical text, non-empty, at most 256 code points; stance must not be a directive enum or an unresolved placeholder
obligations.prompt_marker: ONE short sentence stating the choice itself
obligations.coverage_gap: THE NUMERIC 256-CODE-POINT BOUND IS IMPLIED BY "ONE SHORT SENTENCE" BUT NOT STATED; assessed as LOW MATERIALITY (never observed to bind in C3/C4/C4.2) and deliberately NOT changed in this slice

obligations.host_obligation: every ref in evidence_refs ∪ relevant_memory_refs ∪ considered_context_refs must be inside allowedEvidenceSet(projection) (§15 evidence grounding, LLM-EVID-001)
obligations.prompt_marker: only the exact refs listed below may appear in relevant_memory_refs, considered_context_refs, or evidence_refs

obligations.host_obligation: the rationale carries no factual authority (host: no refs, no evidence channel; language input marks it non-factual)

known_minor_gap: THE NUMERIC 256-CODE-POINT BOUND IS IMPLIED BY "ONE SHORT SENTENCE" BUT NOT STATED; assessed as LOW MATERIALITY (never observed to bind in C3/C4/C4.2) and deliberately NOT changed in this slice
